package main

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
)

// The byte slice deliberately carries bytes that are not valid UTF-8 (0xff,
// 0x80, 0xfe and the truncated sequence 0xc3 0x28) so the three modes must
// agree on lossless byte transport, not merely on a printable string.
func main() {
	raw := []byte{0xff, 0x00, 0x80, 0xfe, 'g', 'o', 0xc3, 0x28}
	fmt.Println("base64:", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(raw))
	fmt.Println("hex:", hex.EncodeToString(raw))
	matched, err := regexp.Match("go", raw)
	fmt.Println("match:", matched, err)
	// The original slice is unchanged after the read-only emitters ran.
	fmt.Println("len:", len(raw), "first:", raw[0], "last:", raw[len(raw)-1])
}
